title: DigitalBridge Group, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-23
summary: DigitalBridge Group, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing results from a special stockholder meeting on April 23, 2026, where shareholders approved a merger with Duncan Holdco LLC. The merger proposal passed with 121,177,032 votes for against 3,900,209 votes against. An advisory vote on executive compensation related to the merger was not approved.
key_points: DigitalBridge Group held a special stockholder meeting on April 23, 2026 to vote on a merger with Duncan Holdco LLC
The merger agreement was dated December 29, 2025, involving Duncan Sub I Inc. and Duncan Sub II LLC as merger entities
Merger proposal approved: 121,177,032 for, 3,900,209 against, 52,181 abstentions (out of 182,392,592 shares outstanding)
Advisory vote on named executive officer compensation in connection with the merger was not approved (28,779,251 for, 96,013,357 against, 335,291 abstentions)
Company securities trade on NYSE under symbols DBRG (common stock) and DBRG.PRH, DBRG.PRI, DBRG.PRJ (preferred shares)
Company is incorporated in Maryland with headquarters in Boca Raton, Florida
